richiami.difetto: The damper upper mounting brackets may fail.  If ignored for an extended period chassis damage may develop.  Additionally it is possible that either or both of the axle parallel links may fail which in worse case would allow the axles to move out of position.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the trailers that are likely to be affected to replace the top damper mounting brackets and related parts including the parallel link assemblies.

richiami.difetto: Insufficient weld applied to king pin box mounting which in exceptional circumstances could lead to the separation of trailer from the drawing vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply the correct weld detail and additional support brace.
richiami.titolo: WELD ON PIN BOX MOUNTING PLATE MAY FAIL
